doc.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024

title: Phil Wilson and the crotch cymbal on The Sound of the Wasp
summary: Rowe relays why Phil Wilson chose Soph for his album: humor and the Chinese cymbal sound.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: All right. I’m going to be careful how I look at my drummer tonight. You know I was talking to Phil Wilson about you.
I had a wonderful conversation with him a couple of months ago, and I phoned him before this interview and I said, “Why did you pick Ed for that album you did about the wasp?”
Yes. And he said, “Well for one thing he’s got a great sense of humor” and etcetera and etcetera, but he said, “I like the way he played the crotch cymbal.”
Yeah. You know what that is?
I think — is it the Chinese cymbal?
Yeah. I had forgotten that he called it the crotch cymbal.
Yes. But he said, you know, you have the touch and he likes the way that particular thing sounds, you can build on it. And he said something about — the pitch was lower so it didn’t get in his way.
